about_short_description.short_description: Spendwisor is a mobile payment and Mobile POS App, with integrated loyalty program solution

product.name: Mobile POS App
product.description: A smartphone-based point of sale system that enables merchants to accept payments, track sales, and manage cash flow digitally without cash handling.

product.name: Integrated Loyalty Program Solution
product.description: A system that tracks customer data and rewards customers directly to encourage repeat purchases and build customer relationships.

product.name: Coupon Management and Promotion Tracking
product.description: A feature allowing merchants to create, distribute, and track coupons and promotions, with transaction analysis for promotional effectiveness.

product.name: Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) Integration
product.description: A payment option that allows customers to purchase items immediately and pay for them later, aimed at increasing conversion rates and average order values.
